question: How old was Jehoiachin when he began to reign?
summary: 2 Kings 24:8 says Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, for three months. 2 Chronicles 36:9 says he was eight years old, for three months and ten days. Two ages, two reign-lengths, same king, same accession.

reconcile.connective: Defenders read the two numbers as one career told twice — eight at a co-regency with his father, eighteen when he finally reigned alone.

discrepancy.connective: The Skeptics Annotated Bible presses the plain figures: the same king, at the same accession, is given two different ages and two different reign-lengths.

excerpts.excerpt_text: At the age of eight his father took him into partnership in the government (Ch2 36:9). He began to reign alone at eighteen.
excerpts.on_tension_rationale: Directly reconciles both figures (8 and 18) by the co-regency theory — the row's central age tension.

JEHOIACHIN SUCCEEDS HIM. (Kg2 24:8-9)
Jehoiachin--that is, "God-appointed," contracted into Jeconiah and Coniah (Jer 22:24).
eighteen years old when he began to reign--At the age of eight his father took him into partnership in the government (Ch2 36:9). He began to reign alone at eighteen.
